profiles.title: Commit-time smoke gate
profiles.description: Blocking deterministic smoke coverage for local pre-commit verification.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote only deterministic, low-cost smoke cases that stay trustworthy at commit time.
budget.demotion_policy: Demote cases that require relaxed invariants, repeated baseline refreshes, or too much artifact output for pre-commit use.

profiles.title: Push-time smoke confirmation
profiles.description: Blocking deterministic smoke coverage for post-push confirmation.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote only deterministic smoke cases that add clear post-push confidence without slowing feedback too much.
budget.demotion_policy: Demote cases that become noisy, expensive, or dependent on advisory-only tolerances.

profiles.title: Release-candidate deterministic suite
profiles.description: Repository-owned replay coverage intended for release candidate sign-off. Commit/push smoke remains small; v8 autonomy coverage is promoted through the advisory suite until each behavior is stable enough to block releases.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote stable deterministic cases that act as release-signoff evidence across core replay, context, approval, and ask-user capabilities.
budget.demotion_policy: Demote cases that keep drifting or require exploratory-only interpretation instead of release-candidate confidence.

profiles.title: Advisory context suite
profiles.description: Non-blocking context-heavy replay coverage for exploratory drift review.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote context cases into stricter profiles only after the drift they watch becomes deterministic enough for a blocking gate.
budget.demotion_policy: Keep exploratory or noisy context cases in advisory review until they stop requiring relaxed interpretation.

profiles.title: v7 workflow advisory suite
profiles.description: Non-blocking v7 workflow coverage for dashboard actions, daemon-adjacent attach semantics, and cancellation variants that remain outside blocking release sign-off.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote only the stable subset into release-candidate; keep dashboard-origin, daemon lifecycle, and cancellation timing boundaries advisory until replay can prove more.
budget.demotion_policy: Demote cases out of this advisory suite if they become duplicate noise without protecting a named v7 workflow boundary.

profiles.title: v8 autonomy advisory suite
profiles.description: Non-blocking deterministic v8 autonomy coverage for task plans, blocked continuation, budget exhaustion, verification loops, memory/index context posture, and branch-search comparison.

budget.promotion_policy: Promote individual v8 autonomy cases into release-candidate only after their replay contract exercises stable runtime evidence without cancelled-fixture shortcuts or noisy context drift.
budget.demotion_policy: Keep daemon lifecycle, provider-dependent behavior, long-running branch search, and UI-only interactions advisory or integration-only until they are deterministic enough to block releases.

profiles.title: Live-provider canary scaffold
profiles.description: Non-blocking advisory scaffold for future live-provider comparison work kept outside deterministic release sign-off.
